title: R41-T026 Building Energy Efficiency – Regression Smoke Test Data Contract
description: Data contract for the six-row synthetic deterministic formula fixture (target = 2 * x1 + 1). These rows are strictly for bounded CPU smoke-test pipeline verification — NOT observations from the UCI Energy Efficiency dataset and NOT evidence of real-world or clinical performance.

x1.description: Finite numeric feature taking values [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]; booleans and NaN/Inf are rejected.

x2.description: Finite constant numeric feature equal to 1 across all six rows (intercept/bias feature).

target.description: Deterministic synthetic regression target equal to 2 * x1 + 1 ([1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11]).

split.description: Explicit fixed partition assignment: train r1..r4, validation r5, test r6.
